name: Antennas & Propagation
summary: How antennas radiate and receive, how arrays steer beams, and how radio waves propagate between them.

topics.name: Antenna parameters: pattern, directivity, gain, efficiency, beamwidth, polarization
Input impedance, bandwidth and matching of antennas
Friis transmission equation and effective aperture
Wire antennas: dipoles, monopoles and loops

Propagation mechanisms: free space, ground wave, sky wave, diffraction
Path-loss models (two-ray, Okumura-Hata, COST-231) and link budgets
